episodes.synopsis: It's game over for one hobby and game on for a new one. High schooler Minami puts down a video game and picks up golf!
episodes.title: Special Encounters

episodes.synopsis: Haruka provides Minami some guidance. Minami’s first shot ever on a golf course is one to remember.
episodes.title: Special Friend

episodes.synopsis: Haruka gives Minami her old golf set. Minami is excited to have the "ultimate equipment" but realizes the driving range costs a lot of money. She gets a part-time job.
episodes.title: Special Job

episodes.synopsis: Minami steps into her very first golf shop. She bursts with excitement at the cute golf covers and golf wear. What really catches her attention is the "utility" golf club.
episodes.title: Special Club

episodes.synopsis: Minami is full of excitement; however, she isn't feeling any rapid progress. Meanwhile, her midterm exams lay ahead.
episodes.title: Special Training

episodes.synopsis: Minami is in for a lot of firsts! She heads towards her very first round at her very first golf course and she hits her first shot with the utility.
episodes.title: Special Round

episodes.synopsis: Minami borrows a light novel from her classmate, Izumi. She unintentionally gains a hint on how to level up her golf game.
episodes.title: Special Finishing Move!

episodes.synopsis: Ayaka suggests they use prize money to play golf on a gorgeous course. Meanwhile, there appears to be something going on between Haruka and Megumi.
episodes.title: Special Caddie

episodes.synopsis: Minami realizes she and Haruka have not seen Ayaka for some time now. Ayaka stopped posting on her social media. What's going on?
episodes.title: Special Buzz

episodes.synopsis: On a rainy day Minami and Ayaka start practicing simulation golf. However, a small challenge barges into their game.
episodes.title: Special Milady!?

episodes.synopsis: The foursome is split up into teams consisting of Minami with Hina, and Haruka with Ayaka, to play a round using doubles rules.
episodes.title: Special Doubles Match

episodes.synopsis: A divine message, or just a dream? There's only one way to find out, and Minami knows where to look for answers... but is she brave enough to go solo for the first time?
episodes.title: Special 'Special'
